decisions: Zero-framework static site (semantic HTML + CSS + vanilla JS): fastest LCP, free hosting, no build step needed for a one-page brochure site
Self-hosted variable fonts (Fraunces serif display, Inter sans) with preload to avoid layout shift and third-party requests
All imagery converted to WebP with art-directed crops from client originals only
Client logo rendered from official vector PDF (bomamor_logo_final.pdf) to transparent PNG; no fantasy logo invented
Motion: IntersectionObserver reveals + lightweight rAF parallax, prefers-reduced-motion respected, no animation libraries needed
Google Maps embed via search query for Kiss Ernő utca 9, Monor; tel:/mailto:/Facebook links as conversion paths
